intent: Promote the source-only Date Picker / Calendar family into a framework-neutral production capability with an explicit date-domain, interaction, accessibility, form, visual, and consumer contract.

provenance.ref: User confirmed that the initial capability includes standalone inline Calendar plus Date Picker in single-date and date-range modes.
User confirmed date-only ISO YYYY-MM-DD public values without timezone conversion; display uses Intl with an application-supplied locale and document language as fallback.
User confirmed manual entry with invalid-state feedback plus min, max, and disabled-date constraints.

User confirmed immediate close after single-date selection, close after the range end is selected, no confirmation footer, one month by default, and an explicitly requested second month only when width permits.
AGENTS.md architecture plus docs/adr/0002-framework-agnostic-core.md and docs/adr/0005-progressive-enhancement-behaviors.md support separate Date Field, Calendar, and composing Date Picker modules.
AGENTS.md and docs/component-audits/date-picker-calendar.json designate shlz-design-source/raw/svg/Date-Picker.svg and Calendar.svg as read-only visual authority.
On 2026-08-28 the user explicitly instructed: Приступай к реализации OpenSpec.
